```plato

    // The scale that brings the ridged sum back to a nominal [0, 1]: the value the
    // sum reaches when every octave rides its ridge. One when Offset is zero.
    RidgedTotal(gain: Number, offset: Number, octaves: Integer): Number
        => offset == 0.0 ? 1.0 : offset * offset * TotalWeight(gain, octaves);
```
